landing.meta.title: Self-hosted URL shortener
landing.tagline: Short links for teams that like to keep things simple.
landing.subtitle: Create, protect and measure short links from one small service you host yourself.
domain.landing.message: This is a short link service. Open the short link you received.
landing.features.heading: Everything you need, nothing you don't
landing.features.subtitle: From the first link to running the whole instance.
landing.feature.accounts.title: Independent accounts
landing.feature.accounts.body: Every user gets their own links, tags and click history, with a per-user quota the administrator controls.
landing.feature.links.title: Short links and custom slugs
landing.feature.links.body: Create a link in a single field or pick a memorable slug of your own; tags and search keep large collections tidy.
landing.feature.protection.title: Password protection and limits
landing.feature.protection.body: Require a password before a redirect, set an expiry date, or stop a link after a fixed number of clicks.
landing.feature.analytics.title: Click analytics
landing.feature.analytics.body: Clicks, unique visitors and daily trends per link, with automated traffic detected and counted separately.
landing.feature.operations.title: Admin console and API
landing.feature.operations.body: Manage users, links, invites and instance settings, issue API tokens for scripts and review the audit log.
landing.feature.platform.title: Multilingual and lightweight
landing.feature.platform.body: English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese out of the box, shipped as one small container with no frontend build step.
landing.meta.description: A lightweight, self-hosted, multi-user URL shortener with custom slugs, password protection, expiry and click limits, tags, analytics and an admin console.
